passed: One combined XPI cold-loads its bundled EN/TR model through the normal local-translate popup while Firefox networking is already offline; no model cache/import/download is used
Packaged model works in both directions and with local automatic detection; unsupported language pairs fail explicitly; idiom quality is recorded separately
Reviewed page and website-dialog text translate with the actual bundled engine offline and can be restored
Bundled local translation reaches live dual captions and native video fullscreen at paired timestamps; stopping restores the player track
A real local VTT file translates offline with the bundled model and exports its unchanged timestamps
Unloading releases the worker; Qwen remains separately selectable with its import and backend controls

observations.input: I was about to give up.
observations.note: Known idiom-quality failure is recorded, not counted as a quality pass.
